summary: Full backend + frontend testing for CLA Aesthetics & Wellness MVP. 8/8 backend pytest cases pass (services list, booking CRUD, validation, status update). Frontend e2e via Playwright validates home sections, sticky nav scroll, mobile sheet, booking form submission (POSTs to /api/bookings, success toast), validation error toast, gallery lightbox, testimonials carousel, /admin table & status update.

ui_bugs.component: Services card image (Signature Glow Facial) and Gallery item 0 (Treatment ritual)
ui_bugs.issue: Images render as broken/empty white area on desktop view — alt text visible but image not loading. Likely invalid/missing image URL in /app/frontend/src/lib/content.js for those two assets.

design_issues.screen: Radix Dialog (Gallery lightbox) and Sheet (mobile nav)
issues: Console a11y warning: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' and 'Missing Description/aria-describedby'. Wrap title in VisuallyHidden or add SheetTitle/DialogTitle for screen-reader compliance.

action_items: Fix broken images in content.js (Signature Glow Facial service image, first gallery 'Treatment ritual' image) — verify Unsplash/CDN URLs resolve.
Add DialogTitle/SheetTitle (with VisuallyHidden if needed) to Gallery lightbox Dialog and mobile Nav Sheet to silence Radix a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses @app.on_event('shutdown') which is deprecated in FastAPI; prefer lifespan handlers (non-blocking).
Bookings have no auth on /admin — acknowledged in problem statement as intentional, but flagged for production hardening.
Booking model: status is free-form string in Pydantic; only validated at PATCH endpoint. Consider Enum for type safety.
PATCH /api/bookings/{id} accepts status as a query param — semantically a body would be more RESTful, but current contract works.
Frontend Booking.jsx: BACKEND_URL has no fallback validation; if env missing, calls will go to /api/* relative root. Acceptable for now.
seed_data_creation: Created multiple TEST_ prefixed bookings via API and one UI booking (TEST UI User). One booking status changed to 'contacted' via admin UI for verification.
